output.question: Who is the parent company of Old Navy?
output.answer: Gap Inc. is Old Navy's parent company. Gap Inc. owns four brands: Old Navy, Gap, Banana Republic and Athleta. The company's own website has an Old Navy brand page titled 'Old Navy | Gap Inc.' with the footer '2026 © Gap Inc. All rights reserved.' oldnavy.com also redirects to oldnavy.gap.com, which is on Gap's own domain.

key_facts.fact: Gap Inc.'s corporate site lists Old Navy as one of its four brands, with Gap, Banana Republic and Athleta.
Gap Inc. has a brand page for Old Navy, titled 'Old Navy | Gap Inc.', with a 2026 Gap Inc. copyright footer.
oldnavy.com sends visitors to oldnavy.gap.com (301 permanent redirect).

passages.quote: Our brands inspire authentic self-expression through our products and experiences.

caveats: None of the pages I opened says outright that Old Navy is 'owned by' or 'a subsidiary of' Gap Inc. The link comes from Gap Inc. listing Old Navy as one of its brands, hosting Old Navy's brand page under its own copyright, and putting Old Navy's website on the gap.com domain.
Don't confuse 'Gap Inc.' (the parent, NYSE: GAP) with 'Gap', the clothing brand of the same name. Gap is a sister brand to Old Navy, not its parent.
